*Sahetukadukādi, Kusalattika* (Patthana 9.6) is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Structurally, it treats the analytical matrix combining the dyads beginning with states accompanied by root causes (*sahetukaduka*, etc.) with the fundamental triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states (*kusalattika*) through the conditional relations scheme characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*.

 Computational analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive internal textual reuse within the Pali canon, recording 589 matching passages shared across 68 other Pali texts, primarily within other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus].
